title: Puzzle 2d Click Deselect Peer Sync
description: Fix puzzle 2d selection sync across windows: group select syncs correctly, but background click and individual element click leave stale group selection on other windows.
summary:
Fixed puzzle 2d multi-pane selection desync after group select: peer panes kept stale area-select preselect in JS, so `pushWasmSelectionAndPreselectToSession` re-applied the old marquee preview after a background click or single-element pick.

- `applySelectionFromPeerSilent` now clears preselect before deriving committed selection chrome, re-syncs scene flags once both stores match, and pushes empty preselect to WASM when needed.
- Added regression test for group-select → deselect peer chrome.
- 116 puzzle/2d/react vitest tests pass.
